bio.text: Patty García is the Democratic candidate for Illinois' 4th Congressional District in 2026, the seat of retiring U.S. Rep. Jesús "Chuy" García.
She worked in his office from 2019 and resigned as his chief of staff in November 2025; she is not related to him.

sources.title: What to know about the 4th Congressional District race to replace U.S. Rep. Jesus 'Chuy' Garcia
